scope: Frozen measurements of this target on the qualified TensorFold Python-based CUDA stack. No new inference, quality scoring or performance run was performed for this model-card update.
hardware: One NVIDIA DGX Spark, GB10 / sm_121, Linux aarch64

runtime.drafter: External stock DFlash 2 from Inco AI, mirrored by z-lab
runtime.baseline: Previous TensorFold-based serving stack using the same quantized target and stock drafter
runtime.availability: Model weights only. The measured runtime and drafter are separate; a generic latest-engine installation is not a certified reproduction.

fidelity.method: Teacher-forced KL on fixed reference top-20 tokens plus an other-token bucket; coarsened, not full-vocabulary KL
fidelity.limitations: Not BF16-lossless, free-running answer equivalence, full tool-benchmark certification, or a direct comparison to KL values from a different test/reference.

throughput.c1_c4_conditions: 50-prompt battery across five domains, two runs per boot and two boots per stack; thinking enabled, reasoning_effort=xhigh, model-default sampling, 1024-token output cap
throughput.c8_c16_conditions: Greedy descriptive screen; not a powered claim of universal speed superiority

rows.label: Single request
rows.metric: Per-request net decode tok/s, TTFT excluded

rows.label: 4 concurrent requests
rows.metric: Aggregate completion tok/s, total cell output divided by cell wall time

throughput.limitations: Same target and drafter in both arms; gains are serving-stack results, not an isolated quantization effect, BF16 speed comparison, or SGLang comparison. C1 net decode and concurrent aggregate are different metrics. Output caps can truncate reasoning; these cells do not measure completed-task accuracy.

reasoning_task_attempts.suite: Internal Hard-V2-R: 30 AIME 2025 problems and a fixed 40-problem MATH-500 Level-5 sample
reasoning_task_attempts.conditions: Four concurrent requests, thinking enabled, reasoning_effort=xhigh, model-default sampling
reasoning_task_attempts.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the three existing per-run means. Each run uses the same number of problems. Wrong and capped attempts remain included; not a successful-task-only latency statistic.

quality.verdict: Registered non-inferiority pass, not proof of general superiority

reasoning_task_attempts.limitations: Descriptive timing summaries, not a preregistered task-latency win or a guarantee for arbitrary tasks. The current stack does not show an additional reasoning-token reduction on this suite.

upstream_thinkingcap_context.scope: Publisher-reported BF16 ThinkingCap versus base Qwen results, NOT measurements of this Kearuga EXL3 release
upstream_thinkingcap_context.hardware_runtime: NVIDIA H200, vLLM 0.29.0; thinking at xhigh and recommended model-default sampling
upstream_thinkingcap_context.macro_average_definition: Equal-weight mean of per-benchmark token reductions; not the ratio of aggregate mean token counts
